intent.instructions: For the supplied business, classify the observed search term by its dominant intent. Use only the state. A navigational search for a brand is not automatically junk.

criteria.buyer: Looking to buy, hire, book, obtain a quote or choose a vendor
criteria.researcher: Comparing, learning, troubleshooting or investigating without explicit immediate purchase intent
criteria.employment: Searching for work, jobs, salaries, internships or vacancies
criteria.navigation: Looking for a particular website, brand, login or company
criteria.unrelated: Clearly unrelated to the business offer, including unambiguous name/word collisions
criteria.insufficient: Insufficient text or ambiguous context to decide

buyer_intent.instructions: Does this exact search phrase express a likely current buying or hiring intention for the business offering, based on supplied text only?

next_step_value.instructions: Rate how useful it would be for a human marketer to inspect this term for possible SEO or ad improvements; do not infer unreported conversions.
criteria: No observable relevance to this business
Potentially relevant term worth manual inspection
Specific actionable intent backed by supplied context or measured conversions
